title.zh: 通过明确第699号法案未意图修正或废止第487号法案各项规定而修正第699号法案的法案
title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE BY MAKING IT CLEAR THAT NOTHING IN SAID ACT CONTAINED WAS INTENDED TO AMEND OR REPEAL THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN.
title.orig: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY-NINE BY MAKING IT CLEAR THAT NOTHING IN SAID ACT CONTAINED WAS INTENDED TO AMEND OR REPEAL THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 699 bằng cách làm rõ rằng không điều khoản nào trong Đạo luật đó nhằm sửa đổi hoặc bãi bỏ các quy định của Đạo luật số 487
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่699โดยระบุอย่างชัดเจนว่าไม่มีบทบัญญัติใดในพระราชบัญญัตินั้นที่มีเจตนาจะแก้ไขหรือยกเลิกบทบัญญัติของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่487
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 699 dengan menjelaskan bahwa tidak ada ketentuan dalam Undang-Undang tersebut yang dimaksudkan untuk mengubah atau mencabut ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor 487
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 699 dengan menjelaskan bahawa tiada mana-mana ketentuan dalam Akta itu yang dimaksudkan untuk mengubah atau membatalkan peruntukan Akta Nombor 487

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Six hundred and ninety-nine, entitled "An Act to amend section
nine of the Provincial Government Act, Numbered Eighty-three, as amended by Act Numbered One hundred
and thirty-three," is hereby amended by inserting at the beginning of paragraph (b) of section nine of the
Provincial Government Act, as in said Act Numbered Six hundred and ninety-nine amended and set forth, the
following words: "Except where otherwise specially provided," and by adding at the close of said paragraph
the following: "Provided however, That nothing herein contained shall be construed to amend or repeal Act
Numbered Four hundred and eighty-seven, entitled 'An Act amending Act Numbered Eighty-two, entitled
"The Municipal Code," and Act Numbered Three hundred and three, amendatory thereof.' "

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 25, 1903.
